agent_report.summary: Built the daily planner foundation from scratch: index.html/styles.css/app.js/state.js at repo root, localStorage-backed state (antfarm.daily.v1) with a bounded 3-priority list and unbounded tasks, keyboard-operable add/toggle/delete (confirm-gated deletes), 360px-safe responsive layout, and AA-contrast colors documented with measured ratios. Added a single Playwright suite (9 tests, all passing) covering every acceptance criterion plus mobile/desktop screenshots for CI's browser-evidence artifact, and appended the schema/architecture/test-runner rationale to DECISIONS.md. Opened PR #13 closing Issue #12.
